implementation.certifier: integer-scaled Shapley maximum-weight closure/min-cut over Boolean-lattice immediate-cover DAG
implementation.validation: full-observation upper bounds matched exact Shapley on a generated game before campaign

interpretation.primary: The deterministic monotone-completion certifier generalizes beyond the prior fixed game: across 40 independently generated antichain games, at 896/1024 observed coalition values it safely certified 51.6% of eligible phi<=0.005 player-game pairs and 74.0% of eligible phi<=0.01 pairs, with zero false certifications and zero solver failures. The much tighter phi<=0.001 target remained hard: 15.8% certification at 896.
interpretation.comparison_to_prior_fixed_game: Prior same-game unseen-seed holdout reported about 62% certification for epsilon 0.005 at 896 calls. Independent-game rate 51.6% is lower but still material, so the earlier result was not purely a single-support-structure artifact; no formal population generalization claim is made from 40 synthetic games.
interpretation.generator_diagnostic: The injected target player was not outcome-filtered and was often not rare (median target Shapley ~0.083), so eligible pairs arose from the full generated game rather than cherry-picked target outcomes.
interpretation.scope: Synthetic monotone binary games only; conditional safety depends on exact observations and trusted monotonicity. No authority to alter lemma-library promotion/demotion or learned-controller policy.

per_game_records_omitted_from_this_compa: Exact generator seeds 3000..3039 and deterministic generator specification in protocol reproduce all supports/truths. Detailed per-player upper-bound records can be regenerated exactly; aggregate is sufficient for the current checkpoint.
